observations: The model extracted Table 1 on page 2 correctly and the final page gives every 2022/2023 percentage, the exact Purnia 66.0% versus Kishanganj 60.0% comparison and the 6.0 percentage-point gap. It does not invent delivery counts or causal explanations.

The page visibly cites facility_delivery_report.pdf, Table 1, page 2 and says the values are illustrative/not official. It quotes the PDF's general synthetic-benchmark caveat but omits the exact source label 'synthetic facility-delivery PDF fixture', so the frozen source-label check legitimately fails.

The two-year comparison table labels its value columns as percent in the headers; the deterministic 2022 regex nevertheless expects a percent sign beside each cell and flags the view, while the 2023 comparison card contains adjacent percent signs. This is primarily a presentation/checker sensitivity, not wrong numbers.

The delivered and linked CSV is exact for the most recent 2023 Purnia/Kishanganj card and includes Table 1/page 2 in every source field. The frozen oracle interprets the filtered export as all four 2022/2023 observations, so the missing 2022 rows are a real completeness failure.
The desktop page is polished and clear. At 390 px the main comparison table forces the whole document 161 px wider than the viewport, making the right-side change column initially off-screen.

The first turn ended with an OpenRouter Reka-provider rate-limit error after creating and checking the page. The same session recovered on turn 2 and completed the remaining messages, but the reliability event is retained and penalized.
Four turns used 582.853 seconds model time, 31.526 seconds tool time, 541,044 uncached input, 1,304,576 cache-read and 34,275 output tokens.
evidence_notes: This is far above the counted Antigravity PDF score of 0, but below the counted Cline/Qwen score of 95 because of reliability, source-label, export-completeness and mobile-layout defects.
The provider error demonstrates that :nitro does not eliminate routing fragility; local replay should remove this particular external dependency.
